additional_info.subject: RE: ID0402323-DC/Si-D/BE-[uyC4UD] Charger offline CRM:01811000630
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Sparki
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / PD 170001336
Charger ID/Serial No.:
uyC4UD
Problem Description: Charger offline
We have identified an error (BG201) related to the door sensor of the dispenser in the logs. Could you please arrange a site visit to check the issue? Specifically, we would like you to inspect the wiring of the BG201 sensor to determine if any loose connections are causing the error.
Additionally, please bring along a spare sensor in case a replacement is needed during the visit.
MLFB NO.
3SE5232-0HC05 -  BG201 Door Position Switch
Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 12/8/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare

We went on site and checked for the problem. Seems there is a small gap between the door of the dispenser and the cabinet. we corrected it so the problem seems to be solved for now. Please monitor the the dispenser for a few more days to be sure.
Br.
